primary.clinical_condition: Suspected bacterial meningitis with fever, neck stiffness, and altered mental status
primary.other_specimen_details: Clear, colorless fluid, collected via lumbar puncture
primary.major_clinical_findings: Patient presented with high fever, severe headache, and photophobia. No recent travel history. Vaccination status unknown.
primary.comments: Patient responded well to initial empirical antibiotic therapy. Further follow-up recommended.
